plan.direction: Daily long-only Cutler RSI(2) dip entry gated by a completed-close long SMA regime filter
plan.economic_hypothesis: Short-horizon weakness may mean-revert more often while the close remains above a longer trend mean; the SMA gate is intended to avoid buying persistent downtrends. Turnover, filtering and costs may erase any gross edge.

time_boundaries.folds: 6 consecutive 30-day test windows; final 3-day remainder reported separately before common terminal liquidation
time_boundaries.history_note: This interval is repeatedly used repository development/validation history, not an untouched final holdout.

costs.impact: 0.5 * previous 20 complete UTC daily log-return standard deviation * sqrt(order budget / previous 20 complete daily quote ADV)
costs.execution_filters: exchange-info PRICE_FILTER, LOT_SIZE, NOTIONAL; adverse tick, lot floor and 5-minute pre-execution VWAP percent-price check

failure_gates.candidate_pass_rule: all gates must pass independently; benchmarks are descriptive only

plan.prior16_audit: research/experiments/20261012T035429Z/prior_evidence_audit.json confirms actual historical evidence for all original 16; none requires a missing-result retry this round.
